title: Miamin
summary: =Mijamin, from the right hand. (1.) The head of one of the divisions of the priests (1 Chr. 24:9).

inlines.v: =Mijamin, from the right hand. (1.) The head of one of the divisions of the priests (1 Chr. 24:9).
(2.) A chief priest who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel (Neh. 12:5), called Mijamin (10:7) and Miniamin (12:17).
